input.quote: 26. APPLICABLE LAW. This Agreement shall be governed, construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the State of California (without respect to principles of conflicts of law).
input.rationale: The Agreement is governed by California law (§ 26) with disputes resolved exclusively in the state or federal courts located in San Luis Obispo County, California (§ 27). California law with California courts sits squarely within the playbook's accepted list (NY preferred; DE, CA or England and Wales acceptable), and dispute resolution is before courts with no arbitration provision anywhere in the Agreement (no arbitration language found on search), so there is no foreign seat or foreign exclusive venue concern. Although venue is in TrueLink's home county rather than our Irvine location, both parties are California entities and the forum remains within an accepted jurisdiction, so no redline is warranted for this rule.
